description: Gate A-D edge search ledger for GBPJPY, following the same workflow as JPN/US500/XAUUSD/NASDAQ/DAX/HK.

gate_a_2026-09-17.cost_bps_source: GBPJPY empirical p95-p99 bid/ask spread band (p95=2.356, p99=6.798), midpoint per config/us500_edge_search_ledger.json per_asset_empirical_spread_bps_2026-09-14
gate_a_2026-09-17.note: All 10 GBPJPY edges passed Gate A -- no kills at this stage.

gate_c_2026-09-17.rule: Exact bid/ask tick replay on Gate B's top-3 finalists + control geometry. Filter to executable_r (meanR) STRICTLY > 0. Winner = argmax(R/occupied_day) among positive finalists. KILL if none positive. Applied to all 10 Gate A survivors.
gate_c_2026-09-17.note: Only 1 of 10 GBPJPY edges survived Gate C -- the steepest Gate A-to-C attrition of any asset gated this session.
gate_c_2026-09-17.recurring_bugs_fixed: build_tick_file_catalog() missing entirely on dailyrangecompletionfade_long and trendpullbackcontinuation_long; wrong dict-key schema (start/end instead of start_date/end_date/filename) on signentropycollapse_short. Same recurring per-edge scaffold gaps as every prior asset, fixed identically each time.

gate_d_v3_2026-09-17.method: shared/edges/gate_d_calibration_monotonicity.py -- AUC-ROC/Mann-Whitney U on raw Step03 OOF predictions vs quote_executable_meta_label. PASS requires AUC>0.5 and p<0.05.

final_disposition_2026-09-17.summary: 1 of 10 GBPJPY edges deployable (10%). Killed-edge folders removed from config/edge_universe.json; folder deletion from disk pending user confirmation.
